jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, 2026 Graduate
jobs.description: building and scaling machine learning models in business applications using large amounts of data, communicating data science concepts to diverse audiences, and focusing on business practicality. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Central AI organization constructs the fundamental infrastructure, data pipeline, frameworks, models, and other capabilities to expedite AI feature development throughout the entire company. Key responsibilities include building and scaling machine learning models in business applications using large amounts of data, communicating data science concepts to diverse audiences, and focusing on business practicality.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Content ML
jobs.description: Senior ML Engineers are responsible for working with diverse stakeholders to guide technical vision, designing and deploying solutions with hands-on software development, fostering an impactful team culture, and staying updated on industry trends. Canva requires at least 5+ years of industry experience in a machine learning engineering role in a Product/SaaS company. Candidates should have experience working cross-functionally with Product Managers and experience proposing automation initiatives with humans-in-the-loop.

jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer (Modeling), Afterpay Risk
jobs.description: As a technical and strategic leader, you will architect and build the ML systems that power fraud prevention and abuse mitigation across the lending lifecycle. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Operations to drive platform-level improvements, influence portfolio and risk-appetite decisions, and strengthen the resilience of our lending ecosystem. You will also lead our shift toward AI-native, agentic risk systems that self-adapt, stay ahead of drift, and surface emerging fraud vectors before they scale.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Modelling), Risk
jobs.description: You will experiment with state-of-the-art algorithms to drive down false positives, collaborate on new product features to drive fraud losses down, use any and every dataset at your disposal to analyse emerging fraud patterns, engineer new features for risk models, and deploy robust models to take action on bad activity in real time. This role can work remotely from anywhere in Australia or New Zealand, or from our offices in Melbourne, Sydney and Auckland.

jobs.title: Data Engineering Analyst
jobs.description: As a Data Engineering Analyst, you create and provide access to high quality and reliable data solutions. In collaboration with your colleagues you deliver and develop best practice data solutions and pipelines. In a DevOps model, you will develop the data pipelines using Continuous Integration; Continuous Deployment (CICD) techniques. As a Data Engineering Analyst, you will contribute value to our mission by providing data integration expertise to develop best practice solutions in the analysis and insight generation of enterprise datasets.

jobs.title: Senior AI Scientist
jobs.description: working at the frontier of applied AI within a growing team, where you contribute to the design and implementation of architecture, evaluation approaches, and technical standards across NAB's AI function. At this level, you will not only build but also lead the design and implementation of AI solutions across multiple areas. This is a delivery-focused role for practitioners who thrive beyond experimentation – delivering business outcomes using advanced AI capabilities (LLMs, agentic systems) in a safe, repeatable, and production-grade outcomes at enterprise scale.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Generative AI
jobs.description: A Senior Data Scientist role in Generative Artificial Intelligence at Macquarie Group requiring a Master's or PhD degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning or related field with strong background in Generative AI, Large Language Models, and NLP, to shape next-generation data science solutions and work on cutting-edge GenAI projects.

jobs.title: Data & Analytics Vacationer Program 2026/27
jobs.description: As a Data & Analytics Vacationer at Deloitte, you'll work alongside experienced teams to help organisations make sense of complex information and turn data into insight. You'll be exposed to work across analytics, artificial intelligence, machine learning and data visualisation, supporting initiatives such as customer analytics, forecasting, operational optimisation and performance improvement. The Vacationer Program is a pathway into the Graduate Program, giving you the opportunity to continue building a career in Data & Analytics after finishing your studies.

jobs.title: NLP/大模型算法工程师 (实习)
jobs.description: 研发和改进现有大模型技术，参与文心一言技术建设，包括但不限于检索增强、提示学习、文本生成、大模型评估分析等技术；推动前沿算法策略应用落地，支撑公司核心业务，利用自然语言处理、机器学习的理论和方法解决实际问题；跟进最前沿的技术和顶会paper，进行前瞻探索。岗位要求：了解自然语言处理、机器学习的常用算法，对NLP热门前沿技术如大语言模型、预训练、提示学习、问答、信息检索、文本匹配等有深入研究或实际项目经验者优先；熟练掌握python，熟练使用Pytorch、Tensorflow等深度学习框架，对数据结构和算法设计有深刻的理解；实习四个月以上，每周至少出勤4个工作日。Base：北京，薪资：250-300元/天。

jobs.title: 算法工程师 (实习)
jobs.description: 蚂蚁的机器学习中台团队致力于构建下一代金融机器学习平台，搭建内部大规模机器学习平台和构建各类机器学习算法框架，探索深度学习、图神经网络、自动机器学习、运筹优化等领域，并支持支付营销、推荐搜索、安全风控、信贷风险等多个金融场景。岗位要求：计算机、数学、统计、运筹学、金融、经济学或相关专业，硕士及以上学历优先；良好的编程功底，至少熟练使用C/C++、JAVA、Python、R等主流编程语言中的一门；熟悉机器学习、数据挖掘、统计学等至少一个方向的主流算法及原理；较强的学习能力和逻辑性，良好的建模思维，对前沿技术有热情。工作城市：上海/杭州，实习时间3个月以上，3天/周。

jobs.title: ADS Core算法实习生

jobs.title: AIGC生成式模型算法实习生
jobs.description: 工作内容包括基于LLM的广告文案生成算法优化、基于diffusion model的视频生成、图像生成、基于多模态输入的视频混剪和视频包装大模型、以及视频理解相关算法。要求2026届及以后毕业、本科及以上学历在读，计算机、软件工程等相关专业优先；熟悉stable diffusion / 视觉理解大模型 / 大模型相关算法优先；有相关实习经验者优先；掌握大模型算法或CV生成模型算法，实现过相关算法或有相关应用；有相关领域高水平论文者优先。地点：北京/杭州，日薪400元。

jobs.title: 数据科学家 (抖音电商)

jobs.title: 搜索排序算法工程师 (实习/WXG)

jobs.title: 搜索算法实习生
jobs.description: 实践多模态内容理解、LLM & Agent等前沿AI技术，分析处理海量互联网数据，构建夸克AI搜索强大的数据底座，在先进的计算资源支持下，将创意转化为影响亿级用户的算法创新。岗位要求：需要计算机、软件工程、人工智能等相关专业背景，对自然语言处理、大模型或多模态技术有浓厚兴趣，具备扎实的编程基础和算法思维，热爱技术创新，拥有强大的学习能力和实践能力。招聘对象为毕业时间在2025年11月1日至2026年10月31日期间的应届毕业生，岗位地点包括北京、广州、杭州。

jobs.title: 大模型算法工程师 (实习)
